_readme: Cards for the Projects grid on index.html, shown in this order. status: live | testing | building | prototype | tool. visible: false hides a card, but this file is public, so anything here can be read. Keep private projects in data/projects-hidden.local.json (not committed). url: null means no link.

projects.name: Atlas Keystone
projects.blurb: The trading-technology and research company I founded and run. Written playbooks with defined risk, multi-agent research pipelines on AWS, and a post-trade review of every position.

projects.name: LoveScout
projects.blurb: AI matchmaking app in private testing on Google Play. Claude sub-agents read only a published list of consented profile fields and propose a short list of matches with reasons. The person decides.

projects.name: TimeCraft
projects.blurb: Gamified Pomodoro timer with project tracking, achievements and analytics.

projects.name: MoGo
projects.blurb: Group movie picker. Recommends films that maximize the whole group's satisfaction by minimizing the spread of predicted ratings: a Sharpe ratio for movie night.

projects.name: SilentJobs
projects.blurb: Job search on silent mode: turns hours of job-board browsing into a short, curated stream of relevant postings.

projects.name: CraveAI
projects.blurb: AI meal finder that suggests what to order by mood, budget and diet, built on a pipeline of restaurant menu data.

projects.name: BeatSite
projects.blurb: A private, browser-based drum machine in a single HTML file. No build step, no server, no accounts.

projects.name: CardMaxx
projects.blurb: My own card-rewards helper: a private, no-login picker that tells me which of my cards earns the most for a purchase, plus a Claude chat about my cards. An offers scraper is still in progress.

projects.name: Mac automations
projects.blurb: Small tools I use daily: ScanCents (scan a receipt, Claude reads it, it lands in a spreadsheet) and Finder Quick Actions for PDF to Markdown, Markdown to PDF and PDF to JPEG.
